story.text: 공주 골목 끝, 작은 밤빵집 앞에 사람들이 길게 줄지어 서 있었습니다.
story.reading: gong-ju gol-mok kkeut, jak-eun bam-ppang-jib ap-e sa-ram-deul-i gil-ge jul-ji-eo seo it-seot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: At the end of a Gongju alley, people stood in a long line in front of a small chestnut bread shop.

story.text: "이 정도 '웨이팅'은 각오해야 합니다." 저는 비행 전 브리핑처럼 진지하게 상황을 설명했습니다.
story.reading: "i jeong-do 'we-i-ting'-eun gak-o-hae-ya ham-ni-da." jeo-neun bi-haeng jeon beu-ri-ping-cheo-reom jin-ji-ha-ge sang-hwang-eul seol-myeong-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "We have to be prepared for this much of a 'wait'." I explained the situation as seriously as a pre-flight briefing.

story.text: 직원이 건넨 '대기표'를 손에 쥐고, 번호가 불리기를 기다렸습니다. 숫자는 좀처럼 줄지 않았습니다.
story.reading: jig-won-i geon-nen 'dae-gi-pyo'-reul son-e jwi-go, beon-ho-ga bul-li-gi-reul gi-da-ryeot-seum-ni-da. sut-ja-neun jom-cheo-reom jul-ji an-at-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Holding the 'waiting ticket' the staff handed us, we waited for our number to be called. The number barely seemed to move.

story.text: 삼십 분쯤 지나자 드디어 저희 차례가 왔습니다. 갓 구운 밤빵 냄새가 골목까지 퍼졌습니다.
story.reading: sam-sip bun-jjeum ji-na-ja deu-di-eo jeo-hui cha-rye-ga wass-seum-ni-da. gat gu-un bam-ppang naem-sae-ga gol-mok-kka-ji peo-jyeot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: About thirty minutes later, our turn finally came. The smell of freshly baked chestnut bread spread through the alley.

story.text: 봉투를 열자마자, 우리는 자리에 앉기도 전에 하나씩 꺼내 '나눠 먹었습니다.'
story.reading: bong-tu-reul yeol-ja-ma-ja, u-ri-neun ja-ri-e anj-gi-do jeon-e ha-na-ssik kkeo-nae 'na-nwo meog-eot-seum-ni-da.'
story.en: As soon as we opened the bag, before we even sat down, we took pieces out and 'shared them.'

story.text: "이런 게 진짜 '별미'입니다." 저는 입안 가득 퍼지는 달콤함에 눈을 감았습니다.
story.reading: "i-reon ge jin-jja 'byeol-mi'-im-ni-da." jeo-neun ib-an ga-deuk peo-ji-neun dal-kom-ham-e nun-eul gam-at-seum-ni-da.
story.en: "This is what a true 'delicacy' tastes like." I closed my eyes at the sweetness filling my mouth.

story.text: 생각해 보니 아침부터 아무것도 먹지 않아 몹시 '시장하던' 참이었습니다. 밤빵 하나로는 턱없이 부족했습니다.
story.reading: saeng-gak-hae bo-ni a-chim-bu-teo a-mu-geot-do meok-ji an-a mob-si 'si-jang-ha-deon' cham-i-eot-seum-ni-da. bam-ppang ha-na-ro-neun teog-eob-si bu-jok-haess-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Come to think of it, I hadn't eaten anything since morning and had been terribly 'hungry.' One piece of chestnut bread was nowhere near enough.

story.text: 결국 우리는 봉투 하나를 더 사서 벤치에 나란히 앉았습니다. 그날 나눈 대화를 들려드리겠습니다.
story.reading: gyeol-guk u-ri-neun bong-tu ha-na-reul deo sa-seo ben-chi-e na-ran-hi anj-at-seum-ni-da. geu-nal na-nun dae-hwa-reul deul-lyeo-deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: In the end, we bought one more bag and sat side by side on a bench. Let me share the conversation we had that day.

words.example_en: This restaurant always has a long wait.
I got a waiting ticket and waited for my turn.
I shared bread with my friend.

words.example: 이 지역의 별미를 꼭 먹어 봐야 합니다.
words.example_reading: i ji-yeog-ui byeol-mi-reul kkok meog-eo bwa-ya ham-ni-da
words.example_en: You really must try this region's specialty dish.
I was so hungry that I wanted to eat quickly.

sentences.en: This restaurant always has a long wait.
I got a waiting ticket and waited for my turn.
I shared bread with my friend.

sentences.ko: 이 지역의 별미를 꼭 먹어 봐야 합니다.
sentences.reading: i ji-yeog-ui byeol-mi-reul kkok meog-eo bwa-ya ham-ni-da
sentences.en: You really must try this region's specialty dish.
I was so hungry that I wanted to eat quickly.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 우와, 줄이 왜 이렇게 길어? 얼마나 기다려야 돼?
turns.reading: u-wa, jul-i wae i-reo-ke gil-eo? eol-ma-na gi-da-ryeo-ya dwae?
turns.en: Whoa, why is the line so long? How long do we have to wait?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 대기표를 보니 삼십 분 정도 예상됩니다. 이 정도 웨이팅은 감수해야죠.
turns.reading: dae-gi-pyo-reul bo-ni sam-sip bun jeong-do ye-sang-doem-ni-da. i jeong-do we-i-ting-eun gam-su-hae-ya-jyo.
turns.en: Looking at the waiting ticket, it looks like about thirty minutes. We'll have to accept this much of a wait.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 역시 침착하네. 기다리는 동안 뭐 하지?
turns.reading: yeok-si chim-chak-ha-ne. gi-da-ri-neun dong-an mwo ha-ji?
turns.en: You're calm as always. What should we do while we wait?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 근처를 좀 걷다 오는 건 어떻습니까? 대기표는 제가 잘 챙기고 있겠습니다.
turns.reading: geun-cheo-reul jom geot-da o-neun geon eo-tteo-seum-ni-kka? dae-gi-pyo-neun je-ga jal chaeng-gi-go it-get-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: How about we take a walk around nearby? I'll keep the waiting ticket safe.

dialogues.question: 대기표를 보니 예상 대기 시간은 얼마였나요?
dialogues.question_en: According to the waiting ticket, how long was the estimated wait?
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 대기표를 확인하고 삼십 분 정도 기다려야 한다고 말했습니다.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 봉투 안에 몇 개 없으니, 서로 나눠 먹는 게 좋겠습니다.
turns.reading: bong-tu an-e myeot gae eop-seu-ni, seo-ro na-nwo meok-neun ge jo-ket-seum-ni-da.
turns.en: There aren't many in the bag, so it'd be good to share them with each other.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 좋아. 근데 이거 진짜 별미다, 그치?
turns.reading: jo-a. geun-de i-geo jin-jja byeol-mi-da, geu-chi?
turns.en: Sounds good. But this is really a delicacy, isn't it?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 인정합니다. 아침을 걸러서 그런지 더 시장하게 느껴집니다.
turns.reading: in-jeong-ham-ni-da. a-chim-eul geol-leo-seo geu-reon-ji deo si-jang-ha-ge neu-kkyeom-ni-da.
turns.en: I agree. Maybe because I skipped breakfast, it feels even more like I'm starving.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 그럼 하나 더 사 오자. 오늘은 실컷 먹자!
turns.reading: geu-reom ha-na deo sa o-ja. o-neul-eun sil-keot meok-ja!
turns.en: Then let's go buy one more bag. Let's eat our fill today!

dialogues.question: 상우가 평소보다 더 배고픔을 느낀 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Sangwoo feel hungrier than usual?
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 아침을 거른 탓에 평소보다 더 시장하다고 느꼈다고 말했습니다.
